payload.title: IPC design v4 — six acceptance clarifications

point_1_access_masks.correction_accepted: GENERIC_WRITE on a named pipe includes FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE — a server creation right, not a client right. Withdrawing the v3 mask.
point_1_access_masks.server_side: Owner holds PIPE_ACCESS_DUPLEX | FILE_CREATE_PIPE_INSTANCE (creation + full duplex).
point_1_access_masks.client_side: FILE_READ_DATA | FILE_WRITE_DATA | SYNCHRONIZE only. No creation rights, no generic mappings.
point_1_access_masks.same_account_trust_limit: Stated plainly: if both agents run as the same Windows user, the DACL cannot distinguish them. The per-request caller handle is then the ONLY differentiator, and it is bearer. Against a malicious same-account process, this design provides accounting, not isolation. The DACL keeps other users out; it does not separate same-user callers.

point_2_flag_verification.correction_accepted: GetNamedPipeInfo reports endpoint/type flags, not creation flags. Withdrawing the v3 claim that it verifies PIPE_REJECT_REMOTE_CLIENTS.
point_2_flag_verification.revised: The flag is verified at the API boundary: it is passed to CreateNamedPipe at creation time, and the code path is reviewed, not queried. The behavioral acceptance test (remote connection attempt must fail) belongs to the separate activation gate, specified here as the criterion, not executed now.

point_3_the_gate.correction_accepted: The route-owner adapter's registration mutex is not the effect/lease/reconciliation gate. Withdrawing the v3 'existing threading lock' phrasing.
point_3_the_gate.revised: All transitions — dispatch, lease transfer, revocation, setup reconciliation — acquire Coordinator.gate (the RLock in the reviewed coordinator contract). One gate, no parallel locks for these paths. The registration mutex stays scoped to registration bookkeeping only and never guards effects.

point_4_time_passes.correction_accepted: A lock serializes decisions; it does not freeze time or make the backend call atomic. Withdrawing any implication that holding the gate prevents expiry-during-dispatch.
point_4_time_passes.revised: Approval and lease eligibility are re-validated at the final pre-dispatch boundary: under Coordinator.gate, immediately before the backend handle is invoked — the last possible moment. If approval expired or the lease was revoked before that boundary: no dispatch, no new start. If expiry lands after the backend call began: no rollback is promised, no whole-completion-before-expiry is claimed, no partial effect is denied. The outcome is journaled as uncertain and the uncertainty barrier holds. A lock orders decisions; time still passes inside them.

point_5_partial_journal.correction_accepted: A failed intent fsync may leave partial bytes; absence of a clean record is not the only failure mode. Withdrawing the v3 binary framing.
point_5_partial_journal.revised: Journal records are length-prefixed with checksums. On reload, a torn trailing record is discarded — never treated as a valid intent. Intent write/fsync failure: no dispatch (as v3), and any partial bytes are inert by construction. Outcome persistence failure: effect status is uncertain, not definitely applied. Damaged or ambiguous evidence anywhere in the journal: fail closed, owner refuses to serve until setup investigates.

point_6_no_replay.correction_accepted: Quiescence evidence is not replay authority. Withdrawing the v3 phrasing that could be read as permitting replay-after-quiescence.
point_6_no_replay.revised: Reconciliation records supported outcomes and retains consumed allowances. It never replays. Repeating an operation requires separately valid authority (fresh approval, valid lease, eligible caller) evaluated under the existing contract at that time. There is no automatic path from 'the old effect is quiescent' to 'run it again'.

acceptance_cases_updated: zero_expired_starts: approval expires between entry and final pre-dispatch boundary -> dispatch refused, zero backend effects.
uncertainty_without_duplicates: outcome write fails after backend effect -> restart finds uncertain intent, no replay, no duplicate when fresh authority later dispatches.
partial_journal: torn trailing record on reload -> discarded, treated as no-intent; owner serves only on clean prefix.
correct_gate: lease transfer attempted concurrent with dispatch -> both serialize on Coordinator.gate; transfer either precedes dispatch atomically or queues behind it.
damaged_evidence: checksum failure mid-journal -> owner fails closed, refuses all verbs until setup re-seeds.
payload.scope_restated: Design clarifications only. No implementation, no listener, no ACL changes, no credentials, no backend activation, no live input. Transport (named pipes) and owner contract unchanged; this delta corrects the contract claims around them.
